Class CraftTweakerClient

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerClient
public final class CraftTweakerClient extends Object
Client-event ZenScript tools: import mods.avogadro.Client;.

Call drawing during a client render event and submit exports on the client thread. Common startup scripts must not call these methods. Runtime guards reject dedicated-server calls before loading the private client bridge. Definitions, matching and shared geometry remain owned by Avogadro. Media option JSON uses the same keys as export command flags; render option JSON uses the Java builder names.

    • exportNetwork

      public static CraftTweakerClient.Job exportNetwork(String id, String parametersJson, String optionsJson)
      Builds and exports one exact network realization, saving the shared reproduction metadata alongside successful media.
      Parameters:
      id - registered network molecule ID
      parametersJson - object with optional counts, probabilities and seed; seed must be a decimal string
      optionsJson - media flags, such as filename, width, height, fps and speed
      Returns:
      retained job handle; counts/probabilities follow the registered network's limits
